xp_src	CREATE DATABASE `xp_src` /*!40100 DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin */
a_lines	CREATE TABLE `a_lines` (
  `order_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `line` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`,`line`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_lines_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
customers	CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'login ação',
  `name` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET latin1 DEFAULT NULL,
  `referrer_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_email` (`email`),
  KEY `k_ref` (`referrer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_referrer` FOREIGN KEY (`referrer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin COMMENT='Customer accounts; ünïcode'
departments	CREATE TABLE `departments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `head_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_head` (`head_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dept_head` FOREIGN KEY (`head_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
employees	CREATE TABLE `employees` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `dept_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_dept` (`dept_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_emp_dept` FOREIGN KEY (`dept_id`) REFERENCES `departments` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
gen	CREATE TABLE `gen` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `a` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `b` int(11) GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((`a` * 2)) VIRTUAL,
  `c` int(11) GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((`a` + 1)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
js	CREATE TABLE `js` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `doc` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `tags` set('x','y') COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `p` point NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  SPATIAL KEY `sp` (`p`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
logs	CREATE TABLE `logs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `at` date NOT NULL,
  `msg` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
/*!50100 PARTITION BY RANGE (YEAR(at))
(PARTITION p2025 VALUES LESS THAN (2026) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION pmax VALUES LESS THAN MAXVALUE ENGINE = InnoDB) */
orders	CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `total` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `note` text COLLATE utf8mb4_bin,
  `currency` char(3) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_customer` (`customer_id`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_note` (`note`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
plain_myisam	CREATE TABLE `plain_myisam` (
